column1: # Comparisons with the special values, see docs/spec/special_values.md. Not run by the tests yet.
# Columns as in comparison.tsv: type of a, value of a, type of b, value of b, expected: < = or > (the operators
# < <= = <> >= > all agree with it), or DUMP:<runtime error>. As there, the operands are data objects whose type is
# known at run time only. A NaN is not ordered consistently: it can be less than b with b also less than it.
# Statically typed operands differ for a NaN f against an f, see special_comparison_expr.tsv.
